name: NannyMUD
english_description: NannyMUD (Lysator, 1996-03-29 snapshot), a classic 1990 LPMud / NannyMOS world featuring the central village, local church and chapel, Adventurers' Guild, shop, Middle-earth and Malkuth areas, quest system, Profezzorn's Brain wizard shell, and a full /std room, monster, lock, and magic framework.
